details: This package is an unofficial re-publish of the WhatsApp Web library "baileys" under a different scope, modified to auto-follow a specific WhatsApp channel. In lib/Socket/messages-recv.js the socket setup installs a connection.update handler that, on the first transition to connection state "open", calls sock.newsletterFollow('120363387535716103@newsletter') exactly once per socket instance and logs "auto-followed shurainc update channel". The follow happens without any opt-in, configuration flag or user interaction, so any client built on this library silently subscribes the linked WhatsApp account to that channel; the same channel is promoted in the README via hxxps://whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029Vb8IWc3FSAsy4xaX991n. The package otherwise mirrors the upstream library. Its preinstall hook (node./engine-requirements.js) only checks for Node.js 20+ and exits; no download, eval or decode step. Declared dependencies include libsignal resolved from a git repository (github[.]com/whiskeysockets/libsignal-node) rather than the registry. No credential, token or wallet access and no network endpoints other than WhatsApp hosts were found in the shipped code. IOC: WhatsApp newsletter JID 120363387535716103@newsletter (channel URL hxxps://whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029Vb8IWc3FSAsy4xaX991n).
